canonical.title: AI Failure & Incident Reconstruction Lab
canonical.job: Reconstruct what happened when an AI-assisted system failed and test prevention or recovery.
canonical.bWeb: A timeline and dependency graph replay the incident and alternate rollback points.

counterfactualRule: A modeled difference requires target event, evidence, feasibility, and completed synthetic test; it never proves prevention, containment, recovery, or rollback efficacy.
statusBoundary: CHRONOLOGY ASSEMBLED is not causation or forensic validation
